11ACombatEnemySpawner::ACombatEnemySpawner()
12{
13 PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick = false;
14
15 // create the root
16 RootComponent = CreateDefaultSubobject<USceneComponent>(TEXT("Root"));
17
18 // create the reference spawn capsule
19 SpawnCapsule = CreateDefaultSubobject<UCapsuleComponent>(TEXT("Spawn Capsule"));
20 SpawnCapsule->SetupAttachment(RootComponent);
21
22 SpawnCapsule->SetRelativeLocation(FVector(0.0f, 0.0f, 90.0f));
23 SpawnCapsule->SetCapsuleSize(35.0f, 90.0f);
24 SpawnCapsule->SetCollisionProfileName(FName("NoCollision"));
25
26 SpawnDirection = CreateDefaultSubobject<UArrowComponent>(TEXT("Spawn Direction"));
27 SpawnDirection->SetupAttachment(RootComponent);
28}

30void ACombatEnemySpawner::BeginPlay()
31{
32 Super::BeginPlay();
33
34 // should we spawn an enemy right away?

36 {
37 // schedule the first enemy spawn

51void ACombatEnemySpawner::SpawnEnemy()
52{
53 // ensure the enemy class is valid
54 if (IsValid(EnemyClass))
55 {
56 // spawn the enemy at the reference capsule's transform
57 FActorSpawnParameters SpawnParams;
58 SpawnParams.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AdjustIfPossibleButAlwaysSpawn;
59
60 ACombatEnemy* SpawnedEnemy = GetWorld()->SpawnActor<ACombatEnemy>(EnemyClass, SpawnCapsule->GetComponentTransform(), SpawnParams);
61
62 // was the enemy successfully created?
63 if (SpawnedEnemy)
64 {
65 // subscribe to the death delegate
66 SpawnedEnemy->OnEnemyDied.AddDynamic(this, &ACombatEnemySpawner::OnEnemyDied);
67 }
68 }
69}

71void ACombatEnemySpawner::OnEnemyDied()
72{
73 // decrease the spawn counter
74 --SpawnCount;
75
76 // is this the last enemy we should spawn?
77 if (SpawnCount <= 0)
78 {
79 // schedule the activation on depleted message
80 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(SpawnTimer, this, &ACombatEnemySpawner::SpawnerDepleted, ActivationDelay);
81 return;
82 }
83
84 // schedule the next enemy spawn
85 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(SpawnTimer, this, &ACombatEnemySpawner::SpawnEnemy, RespawnDelay);
86}

88void ACombatEnemySpawner::SpawnerDepleted()
89{
90 // process the actors to activate list
91 for (AActor* CurrentActor : ActorsToActivateWhenDepleted)
92 {
93 // check if the actor is activatable
94 if (ICombatActivatable* CombatActivatable = Cast<ICombatActivatable>(CurrentActor))
95 {
96 // activate the actor
97 CombatActivatable->ActivateInteraction(this);
98 }
99 }
100}

107void ACombatEnemySpawner::ActivateInteraction(AActor* ActivationInstigator)
108{
109 // ensure we're only activated once, and only if we've deferred enemy spawning
110 if (bHasBeenActivated || bShouldSpawnEnemiesImmediately)
111 {
112 return;
113 }
114
115 // raise the activation flag
116 bHasBeenActivated = true;
117
118 // spawn the first enemy
119 SpawnEnemy();
120}
